profile.name: Dr. Sireesha Rodda
profile.role: Professor, Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
profile.institution: GITAM School of Computer Science and Engineering, GITAM (Deemed to be University)
profile.intro: Academic leader and researcher with 23+ years of teaching, research and administrative experience. Research interests span machine learning, deep learning, medical imaging and dental diagnostics, sentiment analysis, and agentic AI applications. Former Head of the Department of Computer Science & Engineering (2021–2024), with experience in academic leadership, funded research, industry collaboration and doctoral supervision.
